The documentation-site box: a minimal Fedora base composing the local
docs-site candy, which clones the published docs repo, installs its node
dependencies from the committed lockfile, and runs the production Astro
build. The candy's checks run in BOTH contexts, so `charly check box
docs-site-app` proves the site builds and has the right shape without
deploying anything, and `charly check live` re-proves the same shape
against the running pod — which is what makes the bed's fresh-rebuild leg
assert the site rather than merely that the container is up.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `docs-site`
